thread_title: S. flava var. rugelii 'YEW'J MOUTH' Okaloosa Co, FL
breadcrumb: S. flava var. rugelii 'YEW'J MOUTH' Okaloosa Co, FL

posts.body_html:
Oh my effin Lord, these traps are barely a foot tall, but the mouth is absolutely YEWWWWWW-J! Never seen such a wide mouth on a relatively small trap before like this, it'll probably be a jaw dropper once it produces larger traps.

S. flava var. rugelii YEW'J Mouth' Okaloosa Co, FL. the "J" is pronounced "Juh" in case you're wondering. I couldn't think of a more ridiculous way to speall "YUUUUGE" so that explains the answer to the question I'm sure you had and if you didn't have a question to begin with, you probably did have a question after reading this and the answer is including in the explanation as well (MW hyperventilates after talking so long and running out of breath even though he's physically not speaking and shouldn't hypothetically be out of breath...):
